title: Commercial Blender Category, HSN and GST
intro: Twelve live listings in the KitchenaryKart Commercial Blender category — seven immersion blenders and whisks, three jar blenders, one hand blender and one shaker — with the website category, HSN code and GST rate recorded against each SKU.

link.text: Commercial Blender category reviewed on 23 September 2026

rows: Jar blender · 2 L · red (variant of KKCE0014-BLBL)
Milk / cocktail / lassi shaker · single · 180 W
notes: GST: every SKU in this category is recorded at 18%.

HSN: this category is NOT uniform — the twelve listings carry 4 different codes (84198190, 85098000, 84351000, 85094090). The points below are what a chartered accountant should look at; they are observations about the catalogue, not tax advice.

84198190 is recorded against the seven immersion blenders and the lassi shaker. That heading covers machinery for treating materials by a change of temperature — right for equipment that cooks, heats or chills. None of these eight heat anything; they are motor-driven mixing tools.

84351000 is recorded against KKCE0016-SPFBL (soundproof jar blender). That heading covers presses and crushers used in making wine, cider and fruit juice. It is the only listing in the category on this code.

85098000 (KKCE0014-BLBL and its red variant) and 85094090 (KKCE0017-SBL1) sit under electro-mechanical appliances with a self-contained motor, which is the family blenders normally fall in. Three near-identical jar blenders are therefore split across three different headings.

KKCE0015-SBL1 is not a separate product here: it is the red variant of KKCE0014-BLBL and inherits its HSN and GST. It is listed above so the document matches the product document, which names it separately.

The SKU suffix SBL1 is used twice — by KKCE0015-SBL1 (red jar blender variant) and KKCE0017-SBL1 (500 W hand blender). Nothing is broken by this today, but any report keyed on the suffix alone would merge them.
The website names KKCE0010, KKCE0011 and KKCE0012 as HE750WB / HE750WC / HE750WE while their SKUs read HM750W…. The model letters disagree between the SKU and the name on all three.
